stages.role: ERA5-Land formal 2021-2025 acquisition plus optional 2006-2020 background
ERA5-to-CMFD PET bridge and conditional 2025 extension
forcing integrity amendment and authoritative lock
environment audit, frozen-parent reproduction and actual-date spin-up
hydraulic exposure and TN hydrology interface
independent read-only QA, synthesis and final lock
separately labelled forced 1961-2025 sensitivity simulation and TN interface

nonnegotiable_invariants: positive-flow component fractions sum to one
reservoir water, source-tracer and age-moment balances close
flows and storages are nonnegative within registered numerical tolerance
no Gauge output-only correction or post-hoc fast/slow reallocation
no hydrology, reservoir or TN parameter refitting
background_extension_policy: The accepted 1961-2024 product is the formal TN interface. The separately generated 1961-2025 product is sensitivity-only because its PET bridge failed the registered correlation gate; it cannot mutate or replace the formal product.
claim_boundary: Fast/slow flows, stocks, source fractions and water-age fields are conservative modeled states, not tracer-validated endmembers. Bankfull hydraulic exposure is a geometry-and-flow proxy, not a tracer residence-time observation.
